transcript.text: I have a relevant finding from legal. I reviewed Northstar's executed pledge agreement this week and found two requirements that affect the collateral replacement timeline: first, the agreement requires two business days' notice before releasing the existing collateral; second, a tri-party control agreement must be signed before the replacement collateral can be released. I have not yet added these clauses to the transaction checklist, but I'm disclosing them now per our pre-decision routine.
